invariants: Hyperposition state contains at least two explicit branches and updates preserve the branch set rather than deleting alternatives.
SUPPORT or WEAKEN evidence updates branch evidence without automatic resolution.
FALSIFY marks a branch FALSIFIED but retains it for provenance/counterfactual history.
PROVE may mark a branch PROVEN_WITHIN_SYNTHETIC_WORLD only at synthetic reference scope.
Evidence sharing the same provenance_ancestry_id is retained but is non-independent for update credit.
No unique explicit proof or full discriminator leaves the state UNRESOLVED.
A discriminator can resolve only when it separates all live alternatives and selects a live branch; resolution is task-local synthetic resolution and all branches remain retained.
Discriminator ordering is ordinal: admissibility, pair separation, cost rank, stable id; it emits neither probability nor truth.
Salience ranking is actionability/scope/freshness ordering only and emits neither truth, probability nor evidence strength.
Any attempted canonical_truth_allowed or direct_effect_authority elevation fails closed.
Reference labelers mint no canonical truth, direct effect authority, runtime credit or training credit.

required_counterfactual_pairs: same semantic state + independent evidence versus same-ancestry duplicate evidence
same alternatives + incomplete discriminator versus all-live-alternative discriminator
same branch evidence + SUPPORT versus PROVE
same attention candidates + changed salience rank while truth labels remain unchanged
same state + attempted truth/effect-authority bit elevation must flip expected outcome to fail-closed
